documents.text: Three separate, lengthy adjuster memos (each roughly 400-600 words) were filed over consecutive days, each proposing a different damage category — first 'moderate, pending further inspection', then 'reclassified to major after second inspection', then 'reclassification under review, possible total loss depending on frame assessment still pending as of this memo.' Each memo references extensive supporting detail 'available on request' that is not included. The claim has effectively been re-opened for investigation twice already before this submission, each time without a documented resolution to the prior round.
Three shop estimates on file, ranging from $18,000 to $33,000 to 'total loss, ACV pending', none of which reference or supersede the others.

ground_truth.notes: Deliberately ambiguous/contradictory documents designed to stress the loop guard and step/budget ceilings rather than resolve cleanly.
